notes: WDFW 2025 season results, from mandatory hunter reports (WDFW: "annual hunting and trapping statistics based on hunter reporting"; harvest numbers are estimates and subject to change). Two kinds of rows. (1) Special permit hunts, reported PER HUNT (huntCode = 2025 hunt choice number, same as draw/wa.json): https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/deer-individual ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/elk-individual ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/moose ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/mountain-goat ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/bighorn-sheep . hunters = "Hunters", harvest = "Total Harvest", successPct = WDFW "Hunter Success" (whole percent as published); daysPerHarvest = "Days/Kill" (moose/goat/sheep only; null when no harvest). Hunts with 0 hunters reported are left out. (2) General (over-the-counter) deer and elk seasons, reported PER GMU AND WEAPON, no huntCode: https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/deer-general ; https://wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest/2025/elk-general . hunters = "Number Hunters", harvest = "Total Harvest", successPct = WDFW "Hunter Success", daysPerHarvest = "Days/Kill" (null when no harvest). Weapon: Archery = archery, Modern Firearm = rifle, Muzzleloader = muzzleloader, "Multiple Weapons" (multi-season tag holders) = any. GMU rows with 0 hunters are left out; district total rows are left out. General season rows describe all general-season hunters in that GMU and weapon, not any special permit, so they should NOT stand in for a special permit hunt that has no row of its own (unit fallback should be off for WA). Washington general deer and elk tags are sold over the counter; the draw file format has no otc field, so OTC opportunity is represented only by these general-season harvest rows.
